map.name: Azure Terrace

pointMassCheck.limitations: No bike size, suspension, wheel collision, motor or air control.

physics.catchDesign: Velocity-envelope catch, Bezier compression, full flat recovery

springLaunch.entrySpeedPolicy: incoming velocity replaced on trigger entry
springLaunch.landingImpact: broad flat catch; suspension and landing impact pending Unity test

design.intent: Climb toward a visible terrace, rehearse an elevated catch, then reveal the skyline with one high spring.
design.signature: A 10-unit spring lift unlocks an upper route; the final terraced descent releases the tension.

sequence.purpose: Clear runway; show the first lesson before commitment.
Teach sustained throttle while the upper route enters view.
Rehearse reaching a higher catch before the cinematic lift.
Reset bike pitch and camera before the spring approach.
Reveal the 10-unit higher terrace through a tall coin-guided arc.
Reward the upper ramp line while preserving continuous ground fallback.
Descend in two readable steps after the skyline reveal.
Use the long deck as a final relaxed stunt before the finish.
Empty finish release after the last challenge.
